browsers.command: npm run test:team-browser (RUNTIME_SOP_CHROME points to actual Chrome 116 executable)

scenarios: Old service without read-view-images retains complete-guide reads, no separate image route
New service: listing does not read SOPs or negotiate capabilities; explicit reading fetches text view, no complete guide
Nearby thumbnails and opened issue sections fetch exact revision images with at most two active thumbnail requests
No IntersectionObserver fallback uses bounded two-job queue and does not fetch closed issue images
Historical revisions retain annotations and exact-revision image requests
Opening/reopening verified thumbnail preview does not refetch its image
Switching SOP aborts held old image request and prevents stale content
Clearing account aborts held issue image and closes/clears enlarged preview
Advertised corrupt view fails closed with no complete-guide fallback
Account change during decode is detected through private settings before staged pixels enter live DOM

limitations: Native permission approval mocked; isolated profiles and synthetic JPEG fixture.
Same-host real HTTP service and browsers, not physical LAN/two-device/TLS/NAS acceptance.
No many-browser UI load or older hardware performance measurements; SDK load experiment is separate.
Side-panel and folder readers remain on complete-guide reads; no new release or store submission.
